name: the consumed path loses its directory, so a bare remember.md passes
a missing SKILL.md reports a PASS instead of CANNOT RUN
edits: return 2, [f"CANNOT RUN — {path} does not exist. Treat this as NOT RUN, not as a pass."]
return 0, [f"CANNOT RUN — {path} does not exist. Treat this as NOT RUN, not as a pass."]

name: an empty SKILL.md reports a PASS instead of CANNOT RUN
edits: return 2, [f"CANNOT RUN — {path} is empty. Treat this as NOT RUN."]
return 0, [f"CANNOT RUN — {path} is empty. Treat this as NOT RUN."]

edits:
violations: list[str] = []
    if CONSUMED_PATH not in text:
